proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_spawned_creature_mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary mechanic is a controlled summoned companion with duration, command, turn-order, and dismissal semantics. Those semantics already exist only under the spell-only spawned_creature payload family and are unreachable from MagicItemMechanics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While gently swinging this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental."

notes: Structural gap only. Magic action activation and dawn reset already exist, but magic items cannot currently author the summoned-companion family needed for this unit without misencoding it.
